notes.content:
Fixed an issue where moving between floors too quickly in the cafeteria's second floor could prevent the game from progressing.

Fixed multiple text display issues.

Fixed the display problem with Nana's "tsundere" expression.

Fixed an issue where hiding in a first-floor locker during chase sequences (after triggering a specific condition) could cause the game to freeze.

Optimized collision volumes for left and right staircases during chase sequences.

Optimized collision volumes around dorm room exits during chase sequences.

Simplified the搬运 (moving/carrying) minigame. (No more frustration!)

notes.title: 落星METEORITEFALL 3月8日更新公告
notes.content:
Dear Pioneers,

《MeteoriteFall》 has been updated on March 8th at 2:21 AM!
Here are the details of this update:

I. Level Difficulty Adjustments
Reduced the movement speed of dormitory monsters.

Monsters will no longer spawn inside dorm rooms during chase sequences.

Survival stats (four attributes) will no longer decrease during chase sequences.

Increased EXP gained from defeating monsters.

II. Guidance System Improvements
Added a dedicated quest guidance interface.

Added a dialogue history review feature.

Enhanced highlighting of interactive items:

Color-coded based on item type.

Increased outline brightness.

Added interaction prompts (text) above interactive items.

III. Control Optimization
Adjusted or removed collision volumes for certain NPCs.

Optimized diagonal movement logic on stairs and improved rebound mechanics.

Tweaked partial control mechanics (ongoing optimizations).

Players can now move in 8 directions!

IV. Combat Fixes
Fixed an issue where rapidly pressing the R key during combat could cause the game to freeze.

Fixed a bug where initiating combat while gathering could occasionally freeze the game.

V. Miscellaneous Fixes
Resolved known issues related to farming, fishing, skill descriptions, item details, and more.

Important Notice:
Due to significant changes in this update, using old save files may cause unexpected issues. We strongly recommend deleting the savedata folder in the game’s root directory before relaunching. Thank you for your understanding!

We sincerely appreciate your patience and support. The team will continue striving to create, refine, and optimize 《MeteoriteFall》 to deliver the best possible experience. Stay tuned for more updates!

The MeteoriteFall Team

notes.title: 优化公告
notes.content:
Dear Pioneers,

Based on the feedback received, we will soon adjust the content of the Stardust Demo to provide you with a better gaming experience.

I. Stage Difficulty Optimization
Survival attributes will no longer decrease before escaping the dormitory.

Monsters will no longer spawn inside dormitory rooms.

Reduced the movement speed of the dorm supervisor monster.

Increased EXP gained from defeating monsters.

II. Guidance Improvements
Added simplified quest guidance to help players progress through the story. Further improvements to the guidance system will follow.

Optimized item highlighting for clearer visibility of interactive elements.

III. Map Collision Optimization
Adjusted collision volumes based on reported collision issues and will continue to fine-tune them.

We will keep collecting feedback and address adjustments in batches based on complexity. Thank you for your understanding and support!

Best regards,
March 3, 2025
